description: Get Google Trends interest-over-time for `<terms>` — returns the requested trends block (interest over time, by region, or related queries) via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_trends({ q: "bitcoin,ethereum", date: "today 12-m", geo: "US", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

data_type.description: Trends block to return (default "TIMESERIES"). One of TIMESERIES, GEO_MAP, GEO_MAP_0, RELATED_QUERIES

geo.description: Optional two-letter geo code to scope the trend, e.g. "US", "GB"

q.description: Up to 5 comma-separated terms to compare, e.g. "bitcoin,ethereum"

name: serpapi_google_trends
